findings: ETT.tex:1529-1533, alpha = 0. The conclusion holds in the field's form at every Hausdorff E_{>=0}-manifold, mixed ones included, for every causality with an isomorphic chart at each point (Causal.SFALine.line). Each component of sing_0(M) is the image of an inextensible future causal curve gamma : R → M, and gamma is a closed embedding when M is causal. The proof uses no connectedness, no second countability and no absolute minimality. The uncited step at l.1530 (« since M is a differential manifold, it is parametrisable by R », the classification of 1-manifolds; see the row's existing finding) has an explicit replacement at alpha = 0. The X_A-charts into E_0 make sing_0(M) a translation line, because two charts at a BTZ point differ near the axis by a rotation about it after a translation along it: brunswic2021cauchy prop:isom at alpha = beta = 0 (papers/gx/sources/2108.12631/src/BTZ_1.tex:378-383), formalized as Causal.BPrimeE0.exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift. A citation of prop:isom at l.1530 would close the step at alpha = 0 with Hausdorff alone.

ETT.tex:1347-1348 (defi:causal_E0, « J^-(p) = {r = 0, tau <= tau(p)}, that is, the causal past of p is exactly the singular half-line below p »). The definition states this in the model E_0. Section 3 uses it at M (l.1349-1350, l.1565-1573). At every causal Hausdorff E_{>=0}-manifold with an absolutely minimal C, it holds at M: J^-(p) = gamma(]-∞, 0]) for the line gamma through p, hence J^-(p) is closed (Causal.SFALine.Jminus_eq_image, isClosed_Jminus). Causality is needed for the half-line form, by hand and not formalized: in E_0 modulo a tau-translation, the component through p is a circle and J^-(p) is the whole circle, since J^-(p) lies in the component (SFABTZ.Jminus_subset_component) and the circle is a closed causal loop through p. The case is the sibling target T-ett-sfa-btz-e0's question, now answered in Lean for causal M.

kb_proposals: The BTZ line at every Hausdorff E_{>=0}-manifold: Causal.SFALine.line, the field BTZAxioms.line. It needs only [T2Space M] and IsoChartsCoverDEC25 (no absolute minimality, no second countability). It comes from the translation atlas isTranslationAtlas (any family of X_A-charts e into E_0 covering sing_0(M); chart x ↦ (e x).1, inverse r ↦ e.symm (r, 0) on axisParams e = {r | (r, 0) ∈ e.target}) through LineDevelopment.exists_line. Then btzAxioms (BTZAxioms at every such M, C absolutely minimal), singularFlatAxioms_e0 (SingularFlatAxioms at every T2, second countable E_0-manifold, no field left), singularFlatAxioms_iff_massive_line (at every T2, second countable E_{>=0}-manifold only massive_line is left), and Jminus_eq_image (J^-(p) is the half-line below p at a causal M) (T-ett-sfa-line-e0).

Two X_A-charts into E_0 at a BTZ point differ along the axis by a tau-translation: Causal.SFALine.trans_tau (∃ t, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (e' y).1 = (e y).1 + t). It is one application of BPrimeE0.exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift to e.symm.trans e' (he.symm.trans he'), with the open set pulled back by e.isOpen_inter_preimage. rotE0 keeps .1 and tauShift adds t, both by rfl. Neither y ∈ sing_0 nor any causality is used.

Pitfall: rw [coe_chartImage_of_le ...] fails on a goal x ∈ chartImage e U, because that membership is in Opens. Write show x ∈ (chartImage e U : Set _) first, then rw [coe_chartImage_of_le le_rfl, coe_chartSource, e.image_source_eq_target]. E0.axisLine p t unfolds to (p.1 + t, 0): at p = (0, 0), a show and zero_add give (t, 0).
